liveArtifacts.note: The live position predates engine v4 and therefore runs the v2 position implementation, which resolves SortedTroves hints on-chain. Positions created through engine v4 use pylonPositionImplementation and accept solver hints.

history.engineV1SupersededBecause: v1 parked repayment MUSD at BorrowerOperationsSignatures. Mezo's helper forwards its own caller (the engine) as the repayment caller, so the burn happens from the engine. Observed live: transaction 0x431f0f1914756284dbef77327908b9e5d9d50da79e01ee562147c4ba320f9349 reverted with "BorrowerOps: Caller doesnt have enough mUSD to make repayment".
history.engineV3Added: Stage guards: nested legs (swap, position call) are wrapped so a failure reports which leg broke and the inner revert data, instead of a bare arithmetic panic.
history.engineV4Added: Passes solver-computed SortedTroves hints into positions, which validates them in-contract and falls back to HintHelpers with 12 trials instead of 40. On-chain resolution was measured at ~4.75M gas, close enough to Mezo's 10M block limit to be a reliability risk.
